patterns.note: Asymmetrical content sections with large, bold headings on one side and supporting text or imagery on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
Headings use a very large, bold sans-serif font, often in white against dark backgrounds or the accent green, creating strong visual hierarchy and impact.
A distinctive vibrant teal/mint green is used as a primary accent color for key text, logos, and graphical elements, contrasting with a dark forest green and white.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they scroll into the viewport, creating a smooth, engaging content progression.
The primary navigation bar transitions from transparent over the hero video to an opaque white background with a subtle shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Alternating background colors (white, black, dark green) are used to clearly delineate major content sections, providing visual breaks and structure.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background that plays automatically, with large, high-contrast text overlaid directly on top for immediate impact.
Navigation is implemented with a sticky header that dynamically changes its visual style (background color, shadow) based on scroll position, becoming prominent after the hero.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal content sections, where elements fade in and translate slightly upwards as they enter the user's view, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels for navigation and subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and feedback banners, contributing to a modern, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, particularly in the hero and between major content blocks, allowing elements to breathe and maintaining a clean aesthetic.

standout: This site stands out with its bold, high-quality video hero showcasing the product in action, immediately conveying its purpose. The consistent use of a distinctive vibrant teal accent color against dark backgrounds creates a strong, memorable brand identity that feels both innovative and approachable.
